_comment: FDM event thresholds shared by the web viewer (js/events.js) and tools/fdm_common.py. Levels: 1 = info, 2 = caution, 3 = warning. Top-level values are the A320 baseline; 'profiles' deep-merge overrides per aircraft type (an object with "_replace": true replaces instead of merging; "enabled": false switches an event off). Generic demo values, not an operator's approved event set.
